name: Drakensberg
subhead: ESCALPMENT SCENERY, ALTITUDE, AND EXPEDITION-STYLE RIDING IN THE BERG
role: High-appeal destination for premium and international marketing
heroImageAlt: Mountain biker on Drakensberg escarpment trail
overview: The Drakensberg delivers the dramatic escarpment scenery, altitude, and expedition-style riding that international guests dream of — and that local riders respect as bucket-list terrain. Cycle Science packages combine big views, challenging trails, and mountain accommodation into a premium Berg experience.
whatToExpect: Days start with crisp mountain air and build through escarpment routes with unforgettable vistas. Riding is expedition in spirit — prepared, guided, and paced for the altitude and terrain.
trails: Escarpment and mountain trails with elevation, exposure to weather, and varied surfaces. Intermediate+ fitness recommended. Guides manage route selection around conditions and group ability.
accommodation: Mountain lodges or chalets suited to multi-day stays — warm meals, dry kit, and proximity to trailheads where possible.

itinerary.title: Escarpment expeditions
itinerary.description: Guided big-mountain days with dramatic viewpoints and technical sections as per conditions.
